episodes.title: He Left Black Axe Cult And Joined The Vikings….The Revenge Was Bloody!
episodes.description:
Kosi’s story is a tragic journey from the Junior Vikings Confraternity to Black axe, and eventually back to the Supreme Vikings Confraternity — a decision that would have devastating consequences.

Growing up in Ah-kwu-ke Side of Enugu State, Kosi was influenced by the friends around him and eventually became involved with the Junior Vikings. Years later, when his friends moved into the Supreme Vikings Confraternity, Kosi chose a different path and joined Black axe.

But after facing pressure from his former friends, Kosi reconsidered his decision. He eventually left Black axe and returned to the Vikings. To his former Black axe associates, however, this was seen as betrayal.

On the 8 of August 2026, around 8pm, Kosi was reportedly ambushed at Ah-Kwu-kee Gariki, Enugu State, where he was brutally attacked and lost his life.

This documentary examines Kosi’s journey, the pressure that influenced his decisions, the rivalry between confraternities, and how one choice after another ultimately led to a tragic ending.

⚠️ This documentary is presented for awareness, education, historical documentation, and anti-cultism purposes. It does not promote, glorify, or encourage cultism, violence, or confraternity activities.

If you believe young people deserve to know the real consequences of cult violence, share this documentary and help spread the message.

episodes.title: The SUG President Caught in a Cult Initiation
episodes.description:
On February 10, 2020, Nigeria was shocked by headline news: Adegboye Emmanuel Olatunji, the sitting Students' Union Government (SUG) President of the Federal Polytechnic, Ilaro, was arrested by police in the middle of an alleged Black Axe cult initiation.
Dressed in full black regalia—an outfit street accounts tie directly to the highest hierarchy of the movement—his arrest sparked intense national debate. Was the student leader secretly running one of the campus's most feared underground groups, or was he the victim of a calculated political setup and spiritual manipulation as he claimed?
In this documentary, we unpack the complete timeline of the Ilaro polytechnic scandal, analyzing the police reports, the bizarre church-way abduction claims, the internal codes of Black Axe leadership regalia, and the dark intersection of campus politics and cultism in Nigeria.

episodes.title: The Mafia Confraternity: How the Italian Mafia Inspired a Nigerian Campus Cult
episodes.description:
Explore the origin, ideology, and secret internal codes of the Mafia Confraternity (The Family / Ciaffa). Unlike earlier Nigerian campus movements, this group drew heavily from Italian mob structure, Sicilian family hierarchies, and cinematic codes of *Omertà* (the code of silence).
In this documentary, we unpack how the group emerged in higher institutions during the 1980s and 1990s, examining the foundational ideas, power dynamics, and rituals that transformed a campus faction into a secretive underground network.
**In this video:**
 * **The Origins:** How and where the Mafia Confraternity was established
 * **The Ideology:** Italian mob influence, brotherhood oaths, and the rule of silence
 * **Hierarchy & Symbolism:** Family titles, secret handshakes, and visual identifiers
 * **Campus to Street:** How the group evolved alongside other major Nigerian confraternities

episodes.title: How The Most Feared Cult Group Was Formed in University of Ibadan.
episodes.description:
The Eiye Confraternity, also known as the National Association of Airlords, is one of the most talked-about and controversial secret societies to emerge from Nigerian campuses. From its founding in 1963 at the University of Ibadan to its spread across universities and streets, this documentary uncovers the hidden structure, beliefs, symbols, and code that define the group.

We explore their core values, secret language, leadership hierarchy, and traditions—alongside the darker reality of violent rivalries, deadly clashes, and alleged criminal activities that have followed confraternities over the years. What started as a brotherhood has evolved into something far more complex, raising serious questions about identity, power, and consequence.

This video is not just about Eiye—it is about the culture of confraternities in Nigeria, the risks involved, and why many lives have been lost in the name of loyalty and rivalry.

Watch till the end to understand the full picture behind the name, the code “411,” and the truth many don’t talk about.

episodes.title: Why Black Axe Is The Most Dangerous Cult to Join
episodes.description:
**Why is the Black Axe considered the world’s most dangerous cult?** In this investigative documentary, we go inside the "Dark Chronicles" of the **Neo-Black Movement of Africa (NBM)**—better known as the **Black Axe**. What started as an intellectual student movement has mutated into a global criminal syndicate that combines brutal ancient rituals with high-tech cyber-warfare.
We explore the terrifying reality of the **"Bamming" initiation**, a rite of passage so violent it leaves hundreds dead before they ever earn their "strong name." Discover the tactical hubris of their 500-man gatherings and the chilling history of the **Benin River tragedy**, where the promise of brotherhood led to a watery grave.
Beyond the machetes, we follow the money. Learn how this "street cult" has evolved into a global **Cyber-Crime Engine**, funneling billions of dollars through international romance scams and corporate fraud from Italy to Canada. From the halls of power to the depths of the dark web, find out how the Black Axe became an invisible hydra—and why they might be closer to you than you think.
### Key Chapters:
 * **The Origin Story:** From Pan-Africanism to Organized Crime.
 * **The Bamming:** Inside the deadliest initiation rituals in the world.
 * **The Killing Fields:** Why massive gatherings lead to police crackdowns and tragedy.
 * **Digital Empire:** How the Axe runs a multi-billion dollar cyber-crime network.
 * **The Code of Silence:** Infiltrating the state and the struggle to escape alive.
